mechanism: Doxycycline may inhibit CYP3A4, potentially increasing dronedarone levels and cardiotoxicity risk; dronedarone may also increase doxycycline exposure through CYP3A4 inhibition.
action: Monitor for dronedarone toxicity (QT prolongation, bradycardia, hypotension) and doxycycline efficacy; consider alternative antibiotic if prolonged co-administration needed.
